Talents (with a capital T) are not limited to those who can channel. other than the Wolfbrother phenomenon and Min's abilities, there is also the Ogier's Treesinging and possibly Matt's luck. Treesinging specifically is referred to as a Talent by the Ogier, even if the others aren't. {{user|BenPatient}}
